fen_to_board: convert a chess FEN string into a PNG board image with configurable color, piece set, and perspective
extract_all_sprites: extract all chess piece sprites from a Lichess sprite sheet image into a dictionary
extract_sprite: extract a single sprite from a specific row and column position in a sprite sheet image
get_sprites: load all Lichess sprite sheet GIFs and return a dictionary of parsed sprite frames by color and piece set
get_shade: determine whether a chess square is light or dark based on its square index
